chunks: A man came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, and said: “I have a wife who, when I enter, receives me, and when I go out, sees me off. When she sees me worried, she says: ‘What concerns you? If you are concerned about your sustenance, then another than you has guaranteed it for you; and if you are concerned about the matter of your afterlife, then may Allah increase your concern.’”
So the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Indeed, Allah has workers, and this woman is among His workers; she shall have half the reward of the martyr.”

key_terms.آخِرَتِكَ: your afterlife; one’s concern for the hereafter and final outcome
key_terms.أَجْرِ: reward; the divine recompense for righteous action
key_terms.الشَّهِيدِ: the martyr; a standard of immense spiritual reward
key_terms.رِزْقِكَ: your sustenance; worldly provision that Allah has guaranteed
key_terms.زَوْجَةً: a wife; the woman described for her virtuous conduct toward her husband
key_terms.عُمَّالًا: workers; servants acting in devoted service to Allah

ai.seo_question: What reward is mentioned for a wife who comforts and spiritually encourages her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith praises a wife who supports her husband with wisdom, reassurance, and concern for his afterlife. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله commends such conduct greatly, presenting it as a form of service to Allah that carries immense reward.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4369 - A man came to the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) and said: "I have a wife who, when I enter the house, welcomes me, and when I leave, bids me farewell. If she sees me worried, she says, 'What is troubling you? If you are concerned about your sustenance, know that someone else has taken responsibility for it. And if you are concerned about your afterlife, then may Allah (swt) increase your concern.'"
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Indeed, Allah (swt) has workers, and she is one of His (swt) workers. She will have half the reward of a martyr."
